stock.description: Operating as an investment holding company, Hyfusin Group Holdings Limited specializes in the creation, manufacturing, and worldwide distribution of candle products, prominently serving markets in the United States and the United Kingdom. Their comprehensive product line features candles for daily use, a variety of scented candles, and decorative candles, along with other items like diffusers. The company primarily supplies department store groups and buying agencies. Founded in 2017, its corporate headquarters are located in Aberdeen, Hong Kong, and it functions as a subsidiary of AVW International Limited.
